Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing electronic filing of wrecker reports.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reports by vehicle wreckers and scrapprocessors; adding a new section to chapter 46.79 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 46.80 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.79 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A scrap processor may provide the monthly report required in RCW46.79.020 to the department electronically. When reportedelectronically, the department's printed confirmation receipt of thefiling, as well as original ownership documents, must be maintained inthe records of the scrap processor. Records provided in this formatare exempt from the notarization and signature requirements of RCW46.80.090.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A vehicle wrecker may provide the monthly report required in RCW46.80.090 to the department electronically. When reported p. 1 SB 5539electronically, the department's printed confirmation receipt of thefiling, as well as original ownership documents, must be maintained inthe records of the vehicle wrecker. Records provided in this formatare exempt from the notarization and signature requirements of RCW46.80.090.
